notebooks.title: 对角化与指数乘法边界
notebooks.contract: assert B==P*L*P.inv(); assert sp.simplify(EB-(B*t).exp())==sp.zeros(2); assert sp.simplify(EB.subs(t,sp.log(2)))==sp.Matrix([[sp.Rational(1,2),sp.Rational(1,4)],[0,sp.Rational(1,4)]]); assert U.exp()*V.exp()==sp.Matrix([[2,1],[1,1]]); assert U*V-V*U==sp.diag(1,-1); assert (U+V).exp()[0,0]==(U+V).exp()[1,1]; assert sp.zeros(2).exp()==sp.eye(2); assert sp.zeros(2).applyfunc(sp.exp)==sp.ones(2)

notebooks.title: 串联水箱与重根
notebooks.contract: assert x==sp.Matrix([sp.exp(-t),t*sp.exp(-t)]); assert x.subs(t,0)==sp.Matrix([1,0]); assert sp.simplify(x.diff(t)-A*x)==sp.zeros(2,1); assert sp.simplify(sp.limit(other,b,a)-a*t*sp.exp(-a*t))==0; assert len(A.eigenvects())==1 and len(A.eigenvects()[0][2])==1; assert sp.simplify(sp.diff(x[1],t)-sp.exp(-t)*(1-t))==0; assert sp.limit(x[0],t,sp.oo)==0 and sp.limit(x[1],t,sp.oo)==0; assert abs(float(other.subs({a:1,b:2,t:1}))-.4650883158696593)<1e-10

notebooks.contract: assert sp.simplify(y-sp.Matrix([1-sp.exp(-t),1-(1+t)*sp.exp(-t)]))==sp.zeros(2,1); assert y.subs(t,0)==sp.zeros(2,1); assert sp.simplify(y.diff(t)-A*y-f)==sp.zeros(2,1); assert sp.simplify(y.subs(t,sp.log(2)))==sp.Matrix([sp.Rational(1,2),(1-sp.log(2))/2]); assert z==sp.Matrix([t,2*t]); assert z.subs(t,2)==sp.Matrix([2,4])
